title: ETB | Winter Wanderer
description: Adds 13 hazmat suits from the Winter Wanderer update of Escape The Backrooms, including classic and festive New Year variants. Perfect for roleplay, decoration, and Backrooms-themed builds.
body:
# Winter Wanderer Hazmat Suits

Bring the winter atmosphere of Escape The Backrooms into your game with a collection of 13 unique hazmat suits inspired by the Winter Wanderer update.

This mod includes both the classic hazmat suits and a variety of festive holiday-themed variants, allowing players to recreate scenes from the game, build detailed environments, or expand their roleplay experiences.

## Included Hazmat Suits

### Classic Suits

* Green Hazmat Suit
* Blue Hazmat Suit
* Red Hazmat Suit

### Winter & New Year Suits

* Casual Suit
* Cozy Suit
* Festive Suit
* Cheerful Suit
* Shiny Suit
* Winter Blue Suit
* Winter Green Suit
* Winter Red Suit
* Additional seasonal variants from the Winter Wanderer update

## Features

* 13 unique hazmat suits from Escape The Backrooms.
* Includes both classic and winter-themed designs.
* Perfect for Backrooms roleplay and adventure maps.
* Great for decoration, showcases, screenshots, and custom builds.
* Can be used as a standalone cosmetic mod or as an add-on for Backrooms projects.
* Inspired by the Winter Wanderer update.

Whether you're exploring endless corridors, creating immersive Backrooms maps, or simply collecting themed cosmetics, these suits bring the festive spirit of Winter Wanderer directly into your game.
